# Introduction

GSEA analyses correlate NanoString gene expression with PET/CT volume
variables at two visits, adjusted for Age, Sex, and trial Arm. For each
analysis, genes are ranked by the limma t-statistic from a linear regression
of expression against the PET/CT volume, with Age, Sex, and trial Arm included
as additional covariates. A positive t-statistic indicates higher expression
with increasing PET/CT volumes after adjustment.

- Figure 4E: W0 total cavity volume (CAVTOT, mL)
- Figure 4F: W0 total lesion glycolysis (TLG, mL)
- Figure S12A: W16 total cavity volume (CAVTOT, mL)
- Figure S12B: W16 total lesion glycolysis (TLG, mL)

NanoTube `limmaToFGSEA` with a combined gene set of NanoString panel annotations
and the Hallmark collection is the primary analysis. PLAGE with the same combined
pathway set is used for validation. Pathways reaching FDR < 0.05 in both
analyses are reported as the most robust findings.

One barcode (0408230288) is excluded as a quality control outlier. Stimulation
labels are standardised to match the protein data naming convention.

```{r}

  filter(Comments == "success") %>%
  mutate(
    Stimulation = ifelse(Stimulation == "TB",   "Mtb_Ag", Stimulation),
    Stimulation = ifelse(Stimulation == "NULL", "Null",   Stimulation),
    Visit       = paste0("W", Visit)
  ) %>%
  filter(!Barcode %in% "0408230288") %>%
  select(-Barcode)

cat(sprintf("Rows: %d | Columns: %d\n", nrow(nano_data), ncol(nano_data)))
cat(sprintf("Visits: %s\n",       paste(unique(nano_data$Visit),       collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Stimulations: %s\n", paste(unique(nano_data$Stimulation), collapse = ", ")))

# Define covariates
nano_data <- nano_data %>%
  mutate(
    Age = as.numeric(Age),
    Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    Arm = factor(Arm, levels = c("A", "B", "C"))
  )

cat(sprintf(
  "Covariate check - Age range: %.0f - %.0f | Sex levels: %s | Arm levels: %s\n",
  min(nano_data$Age, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(nano_data$Age, na.rm = TRUE),

))
```

# Merge NanoString and PET/CT data

The Donor ID prefix is stripped from the PET/CT data to match the format used
in the NanoString data before joining.

```{r}
pet_data$Donor <- sub("^PD-1-2-0", "", pet_data$Donor)

nano_pet_data <- nano_data %>%
  left_join(pet_data, by = c("Donor", "Visit", "Arm"))

cat(sprintf("Merged rows: %d | Columns: %d\n",
            nrow(nano_pet_data), ncol(nano_pet_data)))
cat(sprintf("Samples with CAVTOT: %d | TLG: %d\n",
            sum(!is.na(nano_pet_data$CAVTOT)),
            sum(!is.na(nano_pet_data$TLG))))
```

# Define gene columns

Gene columns run from ACE to TBP. A guard check stops the document if either
boundary column is missing.

```{r}
col_start <- which(names(nano_data) == "ACE")
col_end   <- which(names(nano_data) == "TBP")

if (length(col_start) == 0 || length(col_end) == 0) {
  stop("ACE or TBP not found in nano_data. Check column names.")
}

gene_cols <- names(nano_data)[col_start:col_end]

cat(sprintf(
  "First gene: %s | Last gene: %s | Total: %d\n",
  names(nano_data)[col_start],
  names(nano_data)[col_end],
  length(gene_cols)
))
```

# Load NanoString pathway annotations

The NanoString immune panel includes its own pathway annotations for each probe.
The annotation column uses :: as a separator between multiple pathway assignments.

```{r}
probe_annot <- read_csv(input_annot, show_col_types = FALSE)

nanostring_pathway_df <- probe_annot %>%
  filter(Is.Control == 0,
         !is.na(Probe.Annotation),
         Probe.Annotation != "") %>%
  select(Gene = Probe.Label, Pathway = Probe.Annotation) %>%
  separate_rows(Pathway, sep = "::") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Pathway), Pathway != "")

nanostring_pathways <- split(nanostring_pathway_df$Gene,
                             nanostring_pathway_df$Pathway)

cat(sprintf("NanoString-defined pathways: %d\n", length(nanostring_pathways)))

pathway_coverage <- sapply(nanostring_pathways, function(g) sum(g %in% gene_cols))
cat(sprintf(
  "Pathways with at least 3 genes measured: %d / %d\n",
  sum(pathway_coverage >= 3),
  length(nanostring_pathways)
))
```

# Load Hallmark gene sets

Only Hallmark gene sets with at least 3 genes measured in this panel are
retained to avoid testing pathways with minimal representation.

```{r}
hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H") %>%
  select(gs_name, gene_symbol)

hallmark_list <- split(hallmark$gene_symbol, hallmark$gs_name)

hallmark_filtered <- hallmark_list[
  sapply(hallmark_list, function(g) sum(g %in% gene_cols) >= 3)
]

cat(sprintf(
  "Hallmark gene sets with at least 3 genes measured: %d / %d\n",
  length(hallmark_filtered),
  length(hallmark_list)
))
```

# Build combined pathway set

NanoString panel annotations are merged with the filtered Hallmark collection.
Duplicate names are removed.

```{r}
combined_pathways <- c(nanostring_pathways, hallmark_filtered)
combined_pathways <- combined_pathways[!duplicated(names(combined_pathways))]

cat(sprintf(
  "Combined pathway set: %d NanoString + %d Hallmark = %d total\n",
  length(nanostring_pathways),
  length(hallmark_filtered),
  length(combined_pathways)
))
```

# limma continuous function

`prepare_limma_continuous`: filters to a given visit and stimulation, removes
samples with missing PET/CT values, and returns an expression matrix and
metadata ready for limma.

```{r}
prepare_limma_continuous <- function(data, stimulation, visit,
                                     variable, gene_cols, min_n = 10) {

  stim_data <- data %>%
    filter(Stimulation == stimulation,
           Visit == visit,
           !is.na(.data[[variable]]),
           !is.na(Age), !is.na(Sex), !is.na(Arm))   # remove rows missing covariates

  n <- nrow(stim_data)
  cat(sprintf("  %s | %s | %s: n = %d", stimulation, visit, variable, n))

  if (n < min_n) {
    cat(sprintf(" -- skipping (fewer than %d samples)\n", min_n))
    return(NULL)
  }

  cat(sprintf(" | range: %.1f - %.1f | median: %.1f\n",
              min(stim_data[[variable]]),
              max(stim_data[[variable]]),
              median(stim_data[[variable]])))

  expr_matrix           <- t(as.matrix(stim_data[, gene_cols]))
  colnames(expr_matrix) <- paste0("S", seq_len(ncol(expr_matrix)))

  metadata <- data.frame(
    Sample = colnames(expr_matrix),
    Donor  = stim_data$Donor,
    Age    = stim_data$Age,                         
    Sex    = stim_data$Sex,                         
    Arm    = stim_data$Arm,                         
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  metadata[[variable]] <- stim_data[[variable]]

  cat(sprintf("  Expression matrix: %d genes x %d samples\n",
              nrow(expr_matrix), ncol(expr_matrix)))

  list(expr_matrix = expr_matrix, metadata = metadata)
}
```

`run_limma_continuous`: fits `Expression ~ pet_variable` per gene.
Zero-variance genes are removed before fitting. Returns the fit object,
results table, and ranked gene list.

```{r}
run_limma_continuous <- function(expr_matrix, metadata, variable) {

  cont_vals        <- metadata[[variable]]
  Age              <- metadata$Age
  Sex              <- metadata$Sex
  Arm              <- metadata$Arm

  design           <- model.matrix(~ cont_vals + Age + Sex + Arm)
  colnames(design)[2] <- variable                   # rename cont_vals to variable name

  gene_vars   <- apply(expr_matrix, 1, var)
  n_removed   <- sum(gene_vars == 0)
  expr_matrix <- expr_matrix[gene_vars > 0, ]
  if (n_removed > 0) cat(sprintf("  Removed %d zero-variance genes\n", n_removed))

  fit     <- lmFit(expr_matrix, design)
  fit     <- eBayes(fit)
  results <- topTable(fit, coef = variable, number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
  results$Gene <- rownames(results)

  ranked_genes <- sort(setNames(results$t, results$Gene), decreasing = TRUE)

  cat(sprintf(
    "  Genes: %d | FDR < 0.05: %d | FDR < 0.01: %d | t range: [%.2f, %.2f]\n",
    nrow(results),
    sum(results$adj.P.Val < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(results$adj.P.Val < 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    min(results$t), max(results$t)
  ))

  list(fit = fit, ranked_genes = ranked_genes, results = results)
}
```

# PLAGE function

`run_plage_continuous`: for each pathway, gene expression is mean-centred and
decomposed by SVD. The first right singular vector gives a per-sample pathway
activity score. The score is correlated with the PET/CT variable using Pearson
correlation. FDR correction is applied across pathways within each stimulation and visit group.

```{r}
run_plage_continuous <- function(data, stimulation, visit, variable,
                                  pathway_name, gene_set, min_n = 10) {

  available_genes <- intersect(gene_set, names(data))
  if (length(available_genes) < 3) return(NULL)

  stim_data <- data %>%
    filter(Stimulation == stimulation,
           Visit == visit,
           !is.na(.data[[variable]]))

  if (nrow(stim_data) < min_n) return(NULL)

  expr_mat      <- t(as.matrix(stim_data[, available_genes]))
  expr_mat      <- expr_mat - rowMeans(expr_mat)
  svd_res       <- svd(expr_mat)
  sample_scores <- svd_res$v[, 1]

  if (cor(sample_scores, colMeans(expr_mat)) < 0) {
    sample_scores <- -sample_scores
  }

  test <- tryCatch(
    cor.test(sample_scores, stim_data[[variable]], method = "pearson"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(test)) return(NULL)

  data.frame(
    Pathway     = pathway_name,
    Stimulation = stimulation,
    Visit       = visit,
    Variable    = variable,
    N_genes     = length(available_genes),
    N_samples   = nrow(stim_data),
    Score_cor   = as.numeric(test$estimate),
    t_statistic = as.numeric(test$statistic),
    P_value     = test$p.value,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}                          # <-- function closes here correctly
```

# Bubble plot function

```{r}
plot_bubble <- function(plot_data, title, subtitle, save_path, filename,
                        x_col = "pathway_short", fill_col = "NES",
                        fill_name = "NES") {

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    cat("No pathways to plot. Skipping bubble plot.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  pathway_order <- plot_data %>%
    arrange(.data[["padj_plot"]]) %>%
    pull(.data[[x_col]]) %>%
    unique()

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(
      !!x_col    := factor(.data[[x_col]], levels = pathway_order),
      Stimulation = factor(Stimulation, levels = c("Null", "Mtb_Ag", "LPS", "IL1B"))
    )

  p <- ggplot(
      plot_data,
      aes(x = .data[[x_col]], y = Stimulation,
          size = -log10(padj_plot), color = .data[[fill_col]])
    ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_gradient2(
      low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red",
      midpoint = 0, name = fill_name
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 10), name = "-log10(FDR)") +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = "Pathway", y = "Stimulation") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black", size = 8),
      axis.text.y      = element_text(color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
      legend.position  = "right"
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    file.path(save_path, filename),
    plot = p, width = 9.5, height = 6, units = "in"
  )

  invisible(p)
}
```

# Enrichment plot function

```{r}
plot_enrichment <- function(ranked_list, pathway_name, collection_name,
                            pathway_collections, stimulation, variable,
                            nes, padj, save_path) {

  gene_set <- pathway_collections[[collection_name]][[pathway_name]]
  if (is.null(gene_set)) return(invisible(NULL))

  clean_name <- gsub(
    "HALLMARK_|KEGG_|REACTOME_|GOBP_|GOCC_|GOMF_", "", pathway_name
  )
  clean_name <- gsub("_", " ", clean_name)

  p <- plotEnrichment(gene_set, ranked_list) +
    labs(
      title    = clean_name,
      subtitle = sprintf("%s | %s | NES = %.2f | FDR = %.2e",
                         stimulation, variable, nes, padj),
      x = "Gene rank",
      y = "Enrichment score"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray40"),
      panel.border  = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
    )

  print(p)

  safe_name <- substr(gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "_", pathway_name), 1, 50)
  ggsave(
    file.path(save_path, paste0(stimulation, "_", safe_name, "_enrichment.pdf")),
    plot = p, width = 7, height = 5, units = "in"
  )

  invisible(p)
}
```

# Run all analyses

For each PET/CT variable and visit combination, limma is run per stimulation
to produce ranked gene lists. NanoTube `limmaToFGSEA` is run as the primary
analysis and PLAGE as the validation. Results are saved and bubble plots
generated for each analysis.

```{r}
stimulations <- unique(nano_pet_data$Stimulation)
all_analyses <- list()

for (analysis_name in names(analysis_config)) {
  config  <- analysis_config[[analysis_name]]
  out_dir <- file.path(output_main, analysis_name)

  dir.create(file.path(out_dir, "Limma"),            recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(out_dir, "NanoTube_primary"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(out_dir, "PLAGE_validation"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(out_dir, "Enrichment_plots"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  limma_fits    <- list()
  limma_results <- list()
  ranked_lists  <- list()

  for (stim in stimulations) {
    data_prep <- prepare_limma_continuous(
      data        = nano_pet_data,
      stimulation = stim,
      visit       = config$visit,
      variable    = config$variable,
      gene_cols   = gene_cols,
      min_n       = config$min_n
    )

    if (is.null(data_prep)) next

    limma_result <- run_limma_continuous(
      expr_matrix = data_prep$expr_matrix,
      metadata    = data_prep$metadata,
      variable    = config$variable
    )

    limma_fits[[stim]]    <- limma_result$fit
    limma_results[[stim]] <- limma_result
    ranked_lists[[stim]]  <- limma_result$ranked_genes

    write_xlsx(
      limma_result$results %>%
        arrange(desc(abs(t))) %>%
        select(Gene, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, B),
      file.path(out_dir, "Limma", paste0(stim, "_limma_results.xlsx"))
    )

    write_xlsx(
      data.frame(
        Gene        = names(limma_result$ranked_genes),
        t_statistic = as.numeric(limma_result$ranked_genes),
        Rank        = seq_along(limma_result$ranked_genes),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ),
      file.path(out_dir, "Limma", paste0(stim, "_ranked_genes.xlsx"))
    )
  }

  # NanoTube primary analysis
  nanotube_sig_list <- list()

  for (stim in names(limma_fits)) {
    cat(sprintf("  NanoTube GSEA (primary): %s\n", stim))

    gsea_res <- tryCatch(
      limmaToFGSEA(
        limmaResults = limma_fits[[stim]],
        gene.sets    = combined_pathways,
        min.set      = 3,
        rank.by      = "t",
        skip.first   = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) { message("GSEA failed: ", e$message); NULL }
    )

    if (is.null(gsea_res)) next

    coef_name <- config$variable
    if (is.null(gsea_res[[coef_name]])) {
      cat(sprintf("  Coefficient %s not found. Available: %s\n",
                  coef_name, paste(names(gsea_res), collapse = ", ")))
      next
    }

    sig_res <- gsea_res[[coef_name]] %>%
      filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05) %>%
      mutate(Stimulation = stim)

    nanotube_sig_list[[stim]] <- sig_res

    l_edge <- tryCatch(
      fgseaToLEdge(gsea_res[[coef_name]], cutoff.type = "padj", cutoff = 0.05),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (!is.null(l_edge)) {
      out_file <- file.path(out_dir, "NanoTube_primary",
                            paste0("NanoTube_GSEA_", stim, ".xlsx"))
      tryCatch(
        fgseaPostprocessingXLSX(
          genesetResults = gsea_res[[coef_name]],
          leadingEdge    = l_edge,
          limmaResults   = limma_fits[[stim]],
          join.threshold = 0.5,
          filename       = out_file
        ),
        error = function(e) message("Postprocessing failed: ", e$message)
      )
    }

    n_sig <- nrow(sig_res)
    cat(sprintf("    Significant pathways (FDR < 0.05): %d\n", n_sig))
  }

  nanotube_sig <- bind_rows(nanotube_sig_list)

  if (nrow(nanotube_sig) > 0) {
    nanotube_sig %>%
      mutate(leadingEdge = sapply(leadingEdge, paste, collapse = ";")) %>%
      write_xlsx(file.path(out_dir, "NanoTube_primary",
                           "Significant_pathways_all_stim.xlsx"))

    nanotube_plot_data <- nanotube_sig %>%
      mutate(
        pathway_short = ifelse(
          grepl("^HALLMARK_", pathway),
          paste0("Hallmark: ", gsub("_", " ", gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", pathway))),
          gsub("_", " ", pathway)
        ),
        padj_plot = padj
      ) 

    plot_bubble(
      plot_data = nanotube_plot_data,
      title     = paste("GSEA (NanoTube):", config$label),
      subtitle  = paste0("FDR < 0.05 | Positive NES: positively correlates with ", config$variable,
        " | Negative NES: negatively correlates with", config$variable
      ),
      save_path = out_dir,
      filename  = paste0(analysis_name, "_NanoTube_bubble_plot.pdf"),
      fill_col  = "NES",
      fill_name = "NES"
    )

    for (stim in names(ranked_lists)) {
      top_sig <- nanotube_sig %>%
        filter(Stimulation == stim) %>%
        arrange(padj) %>%
        head(config$top_n_enrich)

      if (nrow(top_sig) == 0) next

      for (i in seq_len(nrow(top_sig))) {
        pw_name <- top_sig$pathway[i]
        gs      <- combined_pathways[[pw_name]]
        if (is.null(gs)) next

        clean_name <- ifelse(
          grepl("^HALLMARK_", pw_name),
          paste0("Hallmark: ", gsub("_", " ", gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", pw_name))),
          gsub("_", " ", pw_name)
        )

        p_enrich <- plotEnrichment(gs, ranked_lists[[stim]]) +
          labs(
            title    = clean_name,
            subtitle = sprintf("%s | %s | NES = %.2f | FDR = %.2e",
                               stim, config$variable,
                               top_sig$NES[i], top_sig$padj[i])
          ) +
          theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
          theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))

        print(p_enrich)

        safe_name <- substr(gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "_", pw_name), 1, 50)
        ggsave(
          file.path(out_dir, "Enrichment_plots",
                    paste0(stim, "_", safe_name, "_enrichment.pdf")),
          plot = p_enrich, width = 7, height = 5, units = "in"
        )
      }
    }
  }

  # PLAGE validation
  cat(sprintf("\n  PLAGE validation: %s\n", analysis_name))

  plage_results <- list()

  for (stim in stimulations) {
    results <- bind_rows(lapply(names(combined_pathways), function(pw) {
      run_plage_continuous(
        data          = nano_pet_data,
        stimulation   = stim,
        visit         = config$visit,
        variable      = config$variable,
        pathway_name  = pw,
        gene_set      = combined_pathways[[pw]],
        min_n         = config$min_n
      )
    }))

    if (!is.null(results) && nrow(results) > 0) {
      results <- results %>%
        mutate(P_adj = p.adjust(P_value, method = "fdr")) %>%
        arrange(P_adj)
      plage_results[[stim]] <- results
    }
  }

  all_plage <- bind_rows(plage_results)

  sig_plage <- all_plage %>%
    filter(!is.na(P_adj), P_adj < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(P_adj)

  cat(sprintf("  PLAGE significant pathways (FDR < 0.05): %d\n", nrow(sig_plage)))

  write_xlsx(all_plage, file.path(out_dir, "PLAGE_validation",
                                  "PLAGE_all_results.xlsx"))
  write_xlsx(sig_plage, file.path(out_dir, "PLAGE_validation",
                                  "PLAGE_significant_FDR05.xlsx"))

  if (nrow(sig_plage) > 0) {
    plage_plot_data <- sig_plage %>%
      mutate(
        pathway_short = ifelse(
          grepl("^HALLMARK_", Pathway),
          paste0("Hallmark: ", gsub("_", " ", gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", Pathway))),
          gsub("_", " ", Pathway)
        ),
        padj_plot = P_adj
      )

    plot_bubble(
      plot_data = plage_plot_data,
      title     = paste("PLAGE validation:", config$label),
      subtitle  = paste0("FDR < 0.05 | Positive NES: positively correlates with ", config$variable,
        " | Negative NES: negatively correlates with", config$variable
      ),
      save_path = out_dir,
      filename  = paste0(analysis_name, "_PLAGE_bubble_plot.pdf"),
      fill_col  = "Score_cor",
      fill_name = "Pearson r"
    )
  }

  # Cross-validation
  if (nrow(nanotube_sig) > 0 && nrow(sig_plage) > 0) {
    nt_slim <- nanotube_sig %>%
      select(pathway, Stimulation, NES, padj) %>%
      rename(NanoTube_NES = NES, NanoTube_padj = padj)

    pl_slim <- sig_plage %>%
      select(Pathway, Stimulation, Score_cor, P_adj) %>%
      rename(pathway = Pathway, PLAGE_cor = Score_cor, PLAGE_padj = P_adj)

    confirmed <- inner_join(nt_slim, pl_slim, by = c("pathway", "Stimulation")) %>%
      arrange(NanoTube_padj)

    cat(sprintf("  Confirmed in both analyses: %d\n", nrow(confirmed)))
    print(confirmed)

    write_xlsx(confirmed, file.path(out_dir,
                                    "Confirmed_pathways_both_methods.xlsx"))

    if (nrow(confirmed) > 0) {
      confirmed_plot <- confirmed %>%
        mutate(
          pathway_short = ifelse(
            grepl("^HALLMARK_", pathway),
            paste0("Hallmark: ", gsub("_", " ", gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", pathway))),
            gsub("_", " ", pathway)
          ),
          padj_plot   = NanoTube_padj,
          Stimulation = factor(Stimulation,
                               levels = c("Null", "Mtb_Ag", "LPS", "IL1B"))
        )

      pathway_order_c <- confirmed_plot %>%
        arrange(NanoTube_padj) %>%
        pull(pathway_short) %>%
        unique()

      confirmed_plot <- confirmed_plot %>%
        mutate(pathway_short = factor(pathway_short, levels = pathway_order_c))

      nes_limit <- max(abs(confirmed_plot$NanoTube_NES), na.rm = TRUE)
nes_limit <- ceiling(nes_limit * 10) / 10 

p_conf <- ggplot(
    confirmed_plot,
    aes(x = pathway_short, y = Stimulation,
        size = -log10(NanoTube_padj), color = NanoTube_NES)
  ) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low      = "blue",
    mid      = "white",
    high     = "red",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits   = c(-nes_limit, nes_limit),  
    name     = "NES\n(NanoTube)"
  ) +
        scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 10), name = "-log10(FDR)\n(NanoTube)") +
        scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
        scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
        labs(
          title    = paste("Confirmed pathways:", config$label),
          subtitle = paste0("FDR < 0.05 in both NanoTube and PLAGE | Positive NES: positively correlates with ", config$variable, " | Negative NES: negatively correlates with", config$variable
          ),
          x = "Pathway",
          y = "Stimulation"
        ) +
        theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
        theme(
          axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1,
                                          color = "black", size = 8),
          axis.text.y      = element_text(color = "black"),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
          legend.position  = "right"
        )

      print(p_conf)

      ggsave(
        file.path(out_dir,
                  paste0(analysis_name, "_Confirmed_bubble_plot.pdf")),
        plot = p_conf, width = 10, height = 6, units = "in"
      )
    }
  }

  all_analyses[[analysis_name]] <- list(
    limma_results        = limma_results,
    ranked_lists         = ranked_lists,
    nanotube_significant = nanotube_sig,
    plage_significant    = sig_plage
  )
}
```
